purpose: Require generated UPI dispute resolution applications to produce deep architecture, domain, design, engineering, security, observability, testing, self-evolution, and certification-boundary artifacts before generation can be considered successful.

checks: all required architecture-depth artifact names are present
architecture_blueprint.md describes the target generated_application structure
domain_model.md defines entities, value objects, policies, events, and domain exceptions
bounded_contexts.md separates dispute intake, evidence, lifecycle, policy, audit, notification, and mocked external ecosystem contexts
dispute_state_machine.md defines allowed states, transitions, guards, terminal states, replay behavior, and invalid transition handling
api_contracts.md and data_contracts.md define typed requests, responses, errors, persistence records, event records, idempotency keys, and audit records
security_model.md defines PII redaction, input validation, secret avoidance, least privilege, and fail-closed behavior
observability_model.md defines structured logs, metrics, tracing, correlation IDs, audit events, and redaction-safe evidence
test_obligation_matrix.md maps requirements to positive, negative, contract, security, resilience, replay, audit, and performance-smoke tests
certification_readiness_boundary.md states certification-ready-not-certified and prohibits official certification claims

import_boundaries: domain imports only Python standard library or domain-local modules
application may import domain and application ports but not infrastructure adapters directly except through unit-of-work abstractions
infrastructure may implement application ports and may import domain models for mapping
interfaces may call application services and schemas but must not embed domain policy logic
observability and security utilities must not create live payment, bank, NPCI, PSP, or provider calls
tests may import across layers only to verify contracts, conformance, and behavior
state_machine: dispute lifecycle states are enumerated in one canonical model
state transitions are explicit and guard-checked
invalid transitions fail closed with typed domain exceptions
terminal states cannot be reopened without a governed appeal or remediation transition
idempotent replay of an accepted command returns the prior outcome without duplicating side effects
every state transition emits an audit-safe domain event
domain_model: entities and value objects encode dispute identity, transaction references, complaint references, evidence references, timestamps, status, parties, policy versions, and audit identifiers
policies define deterministic UPI dispute decision support without claiming bank, NPCI, RBI, legal, or official certification authority
api_contracts: requests, responses, error payloads, idempotency headers, correlation IDs, and pagination or filtering behavior are typed and versioned
data_contracts: persistence records, outbox records, audit events, replay keys, PII redaction fields, and schema migration boundaries are explicit

replay: event replay without duplicated side effects
